propositions: Superseded tickets with live supersedes/duplicates links cannot be closed without --force because the plan-review close gate demands a certified attestation regardless of administrative disposition evidence.

The plan-review close gate function receives no close_class parameter and cannot see the disposition, making it unable to exempt link-backed administrative dispositions even though the completion verification gate does this correctly.

For genuinely superseded tickets, the review-plan gate blocks with correct findings (work already exists elsewhere), making the plan-review attestation unsatisfiable by construction and forcing use of --force, which degrades the audit trail.

The fix must thread close_class into close_plan_review_gate_check as a keyword-only parameter and exempt only link-backed dispositions (superseded, duplicate) when _has_live_replacement_link confirms the evidence, matching the completion gate's behavior.
Administrative closes of superseded/duplicate tickets should return a distinct audit verdict (not exempt) to distinguish evidence-backed dispositions from type exemptions and --force bypasses.
